digest.component_or_area: LLM framework / Pydantic AI provider integration
propositions: Pydantic AI 1.107 emits PydanticAIDeprecationWarning when rebar uses the legacy openai: prefix, which will change meaning in v2 from Chat Completions to Responses API
Rebar model construction in _pai_model and _resolve_target normalizes ambiguous openai: targets to the explicit openai-chat: qualifier to preserve Chat Completions semantics
ProviderSession custom-endpoint and per-candidate endpoint-override gates must recognize openai-chat: in addition to the legacy openai provider name to maintain endpoint routing behavior

All inferred, configured, and legacy-explicit OpenAI targets across primary models, model-class fallbacks, and provider resolution converge on openai-chat: without emitting the announced deprecation warning
